output.summary: A creeping perennial herb native to Mexico, Central America and Colombia, zebra spiderwort forms dense mats and is widely grown as a houseplant or warm-climate groundcover. Its leaves are striped silver and green above, with purple new growth and deep magenta undersides; prolonged intense sunlight can fade the stripes until the leaves turn purple.
output.edibilityNote: Its leaves are traditionally consumed as herbal teas or medicinal decoctions in parts of Latin America and Asia.
